goal: Complete the agcli Python bindings roadmap on main (Phase 1 already merged). Finish Phase 1 polish (remaining read APIs, Config, typed errors, SyncClient, rich types, tests), Phase 2 extrinsics MVP (transfer/stake/weights + signer lifecycle + localnet E2E), Phase 3 (events, live, localnet/scaffold, admin), then DX/release (py.typed, docs, examples, PyPI CI, security/fuzz). Non-goals: CLI subprocess wrappers, Python validator duplication, bundling agcli binary. Deliver green CI and a merged PR.
summary: Finish agcli Python bindings: phase 1 polish, phase 2 extrinsics, phase 3 features, DX/release.

tasks.name: phase1-polish
tasks.scopedGoal:
Finish Phase 1 polish of the agcli Python bindings on top of the merged Phase 1 base. Phase 1 lives in `python/agcli/` (Python facade) and `python/agcli-py/src/` (PyO3 bindings to the Rust SDK in `src/`). Concretely:

1) Reads. Add native methods on `python/agcli-py/src/client.rs` and matching wrappers on `python/agcli/client.py` (and stubs in `python/agcli/_native.pyi`) for every read named in the acceptance: connection management (`best_connection`, `reconnect`, `is_alive`, `invalidate_cache`); block/hash queries (`get_block_hash`, `get_block_number`, `get_finalized_block_number`, `pin_latest_block`, `get_balance_at_block`, `get_balance_at_hash`, `get_total_stake_at_block`, `get_block_header`, `get_block_extrinsic_count`, `get_block_timestamp`); totals (`get_total_issuance`, `get_total_stake`, `get_total_networks`, `get_block_emission`, `get_subnet_registration_cost`, `get_network_overview`, plus `_at` / `_at_block` variants); `get_balances_multi`; `get_all_dynamic_info`; pinned/historical reads (`get_subnet_info_pinned`, `get_subnet_hyperparams_pinned`, `get_identity_pinned`, `get_subnet_identity_pinned`, `get_delegate_pinned`, `list_proxies_pinned`, `get_coldkey_swap_scheduled_pinned`, `get_child_keys_pinned`, `get_pending_child_keys_pinned`, `get_stake_for_coldkey_pinned`, `get_stake_for_coldkey_at_block`, `get_identity_at_block`, `get_all_subnets_at_block`, `get_all_dynamic_info_at_block`, `get_dynamic_info_at_block`, `get_neurons_lite_at_block`, `get_neuron_at_block`, `get_delegates_at_block`, `get_total_issuance_at_block`); proxy/multisig/child-key (`list_proxies`, `list_multisig_pending`, `list_proxy_announcements`, `get_coldkey_swap_scheduled`, `get_child_keys`, `get_parent_keys`, `get_pending_child_keys`); `get_delegated`; weight commit/reveal (`get_weight_commits`, `get_all_weight_commits`, `get_reveal_period_epochs`, `get_weights_for_uid`, `get_all_weights`, `get_commit_reveal_weights_version`, `get_commitment`, `get_all_commitments`); PoW helpers (`get_block_info_for_pow`, `get_difficulty`); `fetch_portfolio` (in `src/queries/portfolio.rs`). Use `pythonize::pythonize` for serde structs; for hashes return hex strings. Take Python ints for block numbers and `bytes` for raw hashes (and accept hex strings).

2) Config. Add `python/agcli-py/src/config.rs` with `PyConfig` exposing every `agcli::Config` field as Python attributes, plus `load`/`save`/`load_from`/`save_to`/`default_path` static/instance methods. Add `python/agcli/config.py` that wraps it, and re-export from `agcli`. Update stubs.

3) Client mutators. Expose `set_dry_run(bool)`, `is_dry_run`, `set_finalization_timeout(u64)`, `finalization_timeout`, `set_mortality_blocks(u64)`, `mortality_blocks` on `PyClient` (these are sync; use a `Mutex<Client>` or take `&mut self`). Add a `network` getter on the binding by storing the `Network` used to connect inside `PyClient` (also add `Client::network()` to the Rust SDK in `src/chain/mod.rs`, defaulting to `Network::Custom(url)` when constructed via `Client::connect(url)`).

4) Wallet. Add to `python/agcli-py/src/wallet.rs`: `create_from_uri(wallet_dir, uri, password)` (mirrors Rust SDK), `sign_message(role, message)` where role is `"coldkey"|"hotkey"` returning `bytes` via `sr25519::Pair::sign`, `verify_message(ss58, message, signature)` returning bool via `sr25519::Pair::verify` + `Public::from_ss58check`, and a `coldkey_public_ss58` getter alias. Add Python wrappers in `python/agcli/wallet.py`. Update stubs.

5) Rich types. Add `python/agcli-py/src/chain_data.rs` (or extend `types.rs`) with serde-backed pyclass wrappers that wrap the Rust SDK structs from `src/types/chain_data.rs` and `src/types/balance.rs` (`SubnetInfo`, `NeuronInfo`, `NeuronInfoLite`, `Metagraph`, `StakeInfo`, `DelegateInfo`, `DynamicInfo`, `SubnetHyperparameters`, `ChainIdentity`, `SubnetIdentity`, `AlphaBalance`). Each pyclass exposes `.rao` / `.tao` / `.field` getters and `to_dict()` (pythonize). Existing dict-returning client methods continue to return dicts, but add typed `_typed` siblings or take a `typed=True` kwarg returning the pyclass. Keep BC: existing tests that read `dict[str, Any]` keep working. Update `python/agcli/types.py` to re-export the new pyclasses.

6) Typed errors. In `python/agcli-py/src/errors.rs`, replace the single `AgcliError` exception with subclasses created via `create_exception!` for each exit code: NetworkError(10), AuthError(11), ValidationError(12), ChainError(13), TimeoutError(15), IOError(16) — and a fallback `AgcliError`. `map_error` chooses the subclass via `agcli::error::classify`. Update `python/agcli/errors.py` to import the native subclasses (drop the alias-only wrappers). Add tests using fakes/error injection that confirm each subclass is raised (e.g. ValidationError on bad ss58 in `get_balance`, TimeoutError when emulating timeout).

7) SyncClient. Create `python/agcli/sync.py` with `class SyncClient` whose methods mirror `AsyncClient` but block on a single internal `tokio::runtime::Runtime` (use `pyo3-async-runtimes::tokio::get_runtime` if available, otherwise create one). Implement on the Rust side as `PyClientSync` that wraps `Arc<Client>` and uses `runtime.block_on(...)`. Provide every read method from AsyncClient. Add tests covering at least `connect`, `get_total_issuance`, `get_metagraph`, `get_balance`.

8) Rust SDK prep. In `src/lib.rs`, add `pub mod sdk { pub use crate::{Client, Config, Wallet, Balance, types::Network, types::network::NetUid, types::chain_data, error}; }`. Verify the crate compiles with `--no-default-features --features sdk-only`. Add `Client::network() -> &crate::types::Network` to `src/chain/mod.rs` (store the network on connect). Update existing `connect_network` to record it; for plain `connect(url)` use `Network::Custom(url.to_string())`.

9) Tests. In `python/tests/test_bindings.py` (or new files like `test_config.py`, `test_errors.py`, `test_sync.py`, `test_types.py`) add unit tests for: Config save/load round-trip with tempfile path; SyncClient construction (skipped without network — use `@pytest.mark.network`); error subclass mapping via `pytest.raises(NetworkError, ValidationError, ...)`; rich pyclass round-trip. Keep new network-dependent tests behind `@pytest.mark.network`.

10) py.typed. Add `python/agcli/py.typed` empty marker file. Update `python/pyproject.toml` so the marker ships in the wheel (`[tool.maturin] include = ["agcli/py.typed"]` or equivalent). Keep stubs in `_native.pyi` exhaustive.

Build + verify locally: `cargo check --no-default-features --features sdk-only`, `cargo check -p agcli-py`, `(cd python && maturin develop --manifest-path agcli-py/Cargo.toml)`, `(cd python && pytest -m "not network")`. Commit and push the cloud-agent branch — do NOT open a PR (later worker stacks on top and opens the consolidated PR). End with the structured handoff.

Quality bar: keep the binding-side code idiomatic (no narrative comments, no TODO placeholders); push validation up to the binding boundary so SDK errors carry useful messages.
acceptance: All listed Phase 1 read APIs are exposed on agcli.AsyncClient and on the native client (best_connection, reconnect, is_alive, invalidate_cache, block-hash/balance-at/total-stake-at queries, get_block_number/get_finalized_block_number, totals, get_balances_multi, get_all_dynamic_info, pinned/historical _at_block/_at_hash variants, list_proxies, list_multisig_pending, list_proxy_announcements, get_coldkey_swap_scheduled, get_child_keys, get_parent_keys, get_pending_child_keys, get_delegated, weight commit + reveal queries, get_block_info_for_pow, get_difficulty, fetch_portfolio).
agcli.Config exposes load/save/load_from/save_to with the same field set as the Rust SDK's Config.
AsyncClient supports set_dry_run/is_dry_run, set_finalization_timeout/finalization_timeout, set_mortality_blocks/mortality_blocks, and a `network` property returning a Network enum value.
agcli.Wallet exposes create_from_uri, sign_message(coldkey|hotkey, bytes) -> bytes, verify_message(ss58, message, signature) -> bool, and coldkey_public_ss58 (alias of coldkey_ss58).

Rich Python types (TypedDict or pyclass) are added for SubnetInfo, NeuronInfo, NeuronInfoLite, Metagraph, StakeInfo, DelegateInfo, DynamicInfo, SubnetHyperparameters, ChainIdentity, SubnetIdentity, AlphaBalance and exported from `agcli.types`.
errors.map_error raises NetworkError/AuthError/ValidationError/ChainError/TimeoutError/IOError subclasses based on agcli::error::classify; tests cover each subclass.
agcli.sync.SyncClient mirrors AsyncClient via a private tokio runtime; tests verify get_balance and get_metagraph round-trip.

Rust SDK gains Client::network() -> &Network and an `agcli::sdk` module that re-exports Client, Wallet, Balance, Network, NetUid, Config, types::chain_data::*; the crate compiles with default-features=false and `--features sdk-only`.
py.typed marker is present, _native.pyi is updated to match all new bindings, agcli/__init__.py re-exports new public names.
pytest -m "not network" passes locally; CI workflow `python` job still runs cleanly with the new tests.

tasks.name: phase2-extrinsics
tasks.scopedGoal:
Phase 2: extrinsics MVP for the agcli Python bindings, stacked on top of phase1-polish. Add native methods on `python/agcli-py/src/client.rs` and matching async wrappers on `python/agcli/client.py` (plus stubs) for the priority extrinsics:

- transfer (`transfer`, `transfer_all`)
- staking (`add_stake`, `remove_stake`, `add_stake_limit`, `remove_stake_limit`, `move_stake`, `swap_stake`, `swap_stake_limit`, `transfer_stake`, `unstake_all`, `unstake_all_alpha`, `recycle_alpha`, `burn_alpha`, `claim_root`)
- weights (`set_weights`, `commit_weights`, `reveal_weights`)
- subnet registration (`register_network`, `burned_register`, `pow_register`, `root_register`, `dissolve_network`)
- proxy (`add_proxy`, `remove_proxy`, `create_pure_proxy`, `kill_pure_proxy`, `try_associate_hotkey`, `schedule_swap_coldkey`, `swap_hotkey`, `set_subnet_identity`)

API shape (all async): `await client.transfer(wallet, dest_ss58, amount: Balance|int, *, wait=True, mev=True, dry_run=False, finalization_timeout=None, mortality_blocks=None) -> str` returning the extrinsic hash. `wallet` is the Python `Wallet`; the binding extracts the unlocked coldkey/hotkey pair as appropriate (transfers + stake use coldkey; weights use hotkey). When `mev=True` and the corresponding `_mev` SDK fn exists, route to `sign_submit_or_mev` (already in the SDK) so the user gets a single switch. When `dry_run=True`, set the binding's per-call dry-run on a cloned client (`Client::set_dry_run(true)`) before submitting.

Signer lifecycle:
- Add `Wallet.unlock_coldkey_with_password(password)` and `Wallet.is_coldkey_unlocked` / `Wallet.is_hotkey_loaded` properties.
- Add a context manager `with wallet.session(password=...)` in `python/agcli/wallet.py` that unlocks on enter, lets the caller call extrinsics, and re-locks on exit (drop the inner pair via Rust-side `lock()` method that resets `coldkey: None`).
- The Rust binding stores the `Wallet` behind `Mutex` so signer state crosses the await boundary safely.

Validation at binding boundary:
- Reject negative amounts, malformed SS58, weight tensors with mismatched lengths, netuid > u16::MAX, etc., raising `agcli.ValidationError` with a clear message before touching the chain.
- Validate weight payloads (`uids` and `values` lists same length, values in u16 range).

Localnet integration tests:
- Add `python/tests/test_extrinsics_localnet.py` with `@pytest.mark.localnet` (register a new marker in `pyproject.toml`) and `@pytest.mark.asyncio`. Tests connect to ws://127.0.0.1:9944 and use Substrate dev URIs (//Alice, //Bob) via `Wallet.create_from_uri`. Cover: transfer Alice -> Bob, add_stake Alice on subnet 0, remove_stake, set_weights for a tiny netuid, register_network and dissolve_network, proxy add/remove. Skip cleanly when env var `AGCLI_LOCALNET_WS` is unset or the node is unreachable.
- Update CI: keep `pytest -m "not network and not localnet"` for the default job; the localnet job is optional and not required for green CI yet (we'll wire it later if env permits). Document running localnet tests in `docs/tutorials/python-sdk.md` (or similar).

Updates needed in `python/agcli-py/src/`:
- `extrinsics.rs` (new file) holds the binding glue.
- `lib.rs` registers the new methods on PyClient.
- `python/agcli/client.py` and `_native.pyi` mirror.
- `python/agcli/wallet.py` gains `session(...)` context manager.

Verify locally: `cargo check -p agcli-py`, `(cd python && maturin develop --manifest-path agcli-py/Cargo.toml)`, `(cd python && pytest -m "not network and not localnet")` should be green. If a localnet container can be spun up easily (docker run --rm -d -p 9944:9944 ghcr.io/opentensor/subtensor:latest --dev or equivalent — best effort), also run `pytest -m localnet` and report results in the handoff. If not, the marker keeps them out of CI.

Commit and push the cloud-agent branch; do NOT open a PR. The release worker downstream will stack and open the consolidated PR.
acceptance: Each priority extrinsic listed in the goal is exposed on AsyncClient with wait=True, mev=True, dry_run=False kwargs and signature `(wallet, ...)` taking a unlocked Python Wallet.
Transfer + add_stake + remove_stake + set_weights + commit_weights + reveal_weights are exercised by `python/tests/test_extrinsics_localnet.py` with `@pytest.mark.localnet`.
Validation errors (bad ss58, mismatched weight vectors, negative amount, oversized netuid) raise `agcli.ValidationError` before the chain call.
Wallet exposes `session(password=...)` context manager and `is_coldkey_unlocked` / `is_hotkey_loaded` properties.
`pytest -m "not network and not localnet"` is green on the worker branch.
`cargo check -p agcli-py` is clean.

tasks.name: phase3-features
tasks.scopedGoal:
Phase 3: events, live, localnet, scaffold, admin. Stacked on phase2-extrinsics.

1) Events. Expose async iterator-style subscriptions backed by `agcli::events::subscribe_events`, `subscribe_events_filtered`, `subscribe_blocks`. In `python/agcli-py/src/events.rs` (new), implement a `PyEventStream` PyO3 class that drives a tokio `mpsc` channel from a spawned task. Expose on AsyncClient: `subscribe_events(filter=None) -> async iterator of dict`, `subscribe_events_filtered(filter: dict|EventFilter) -> ...`, `subscribe_blocks() -> async iterator of dict`. `EventFilter` is a Python dataclass mirroring `agcli::events::EventFilter`. Each event yielded carries `block_number`, `pallet`, `variant`, `fields`, `extrinsic_index`. Document cancellation: closing the iterator (drop) cancels the underlying subscription. Add a unit test that constructs the dataclass and round-trips fields; mark live subscription tests `@pytest.mark.localnet`.

2) Live views. Expose `agcli.live` module with `live_dynamic`, `live_metagraph`, `live_portfolio` async functions thin-wrapping `agcli::live::*`. Each accepts an `AsyncClient` (the binding extracts the Arc<Client>) and an `interval_secs: int`. They return None and print to stdout exactly like the Rust SDK; mark them as best-effort interactive helpers. Tests: smoke-import only (live loops require a live chain).

3) Localnet. New module `agcli.localnet` re-exports `start`, `stop`, `status`, `reset`, `logs`, `dev_accounts` from `agcli::localnet`. The binding takes a `LocalnetConfig` pyclass mirroring the Rust struct. `start` and `reset` return a `LocalnetInfo` pyclass. `status` returns a `LocalnetStatus` pyclass. `dev_accounts()` returns a list of `DevAccount` pyclasses. Add tests that exercise `dev_accounts()` (no docker required) and `status` against a non-existent container (returns an inactive status).

4) Scaffold. New `agcli.scaffold` module exposes `load_config(path: str) -> ScaffoldConfig` and `async run(config: ScaffoldConfig) -> ScaffoldResult`. ScaffoldConfig/SubnetConfig/NeuronConfig/ScaffoldResult/SubnetResult/NeuronResult are pyclasses mirroring the Rust structs. Add a unit test that round-trips a sample TOML config (load_config / re-serialize equivalence) without actually running the scaffold (which requires localnet).

5) Admin. New `agcli.admin` module that exposes every `set_*` admin function in `src/admin.rs` (set_tempo, set_max_allowed_validators, set_max_allowed_uids, set_immunity_period, set_min_allowed_weights, set_max_weight_limit, set_weights_set_rate_limit, set_commit_reveal_weights_enabled, set_difficulty, set_bonds_moving_average, set_target_registrations_per_interval, set_activity_cutoff, set_serving_rate_limit, set_default_take, set_tx_rate_limit, set_min_difficulty, set_max_difficulty, set_adjustment_interval, set_adjustment_alpha, set_kappa, set_rho, set_min_burn, set_max_burn, set_liquid_alpha_enabled, set_alpha_values, set_yuma3_enabled, set_bonds_penalty, set_subnet_moving_alpha, set_mechanism_count, set_mechanism_emission_split, set_stake_threshold, set_nominator_min_required_stake, set_network_registration_allowed, set_network_pow_registration_allowed, raw_admin_call) as async free functions taking (client, wallet, netuid, value). Also expose `known_params()` returning the list of `(name, description, valid_values)` tuples.

All new bindings live in `python/agcli-py/src/{events,live,localnet,scaffold,admin}.rs`. Register modules from `lib.rs`. Mirror in `python/agcli/{events,live,localnet,scaffold,admin}.py`. Update stubs in `_native.pyi`. Keep all event/live/localnet methods marked `not network and not localnet` for CI by default.

Verify: `cargo check -p agcli-py`, `(cd python && maturin develop --manifest-path agcli-py/Cargo.toml)`, `(cd python && pytest -m "not network and not localnet")` is green.

Commit and push; do NOT open a PR.
acceptance: agcli.events exposes EventFilter dataclass + AsyncClient.subscribe_events / subscribe_events_filtered / subscribe_blocks returning async iterators.
agcli.live exposes live_dynamic / live_metagraph / live_portfolio async helpers.
agcli.localnet exposes start/stop/status/reset/logs/dev_accounts plus LocalnetConfig/LocalnetInfo/LocalnetStatus/DevAccount pyclasses.
agcli.scaffold exposes load_config + async run plus ScaffoldConfig/SubnetConfig/NeuronConfig/ScaffoldResult pyclasses.
agcli.admin exposes every set_* admin extrinsic from src/admin.rs plus known_params().
`pytest -m "not network and not localnet"` passes on the worker branch.
`cargo check -p agcli-py` is clean.

tasks.name: dx-release
tasks.scopedGoal:
DX + release. Stacks on phase3-features and opens the consolidated draft PR against `main`.

1) Type metadata. Confirm `python/agcli/py.typed` exists; ensure `python/pyproject.toml` ships it in the wheel. Final pass over `python/agcli/_native.pyi` so every public binding has a precise signature, dataclasses included.

2) Docs. Add `docs/tutorials/python-sdk.md` covering: install (`pip install agcli`), connect (`AsyncClient.connect_network` + `SyncClient`), wallet lifecycle (`Wallet.create`, `create_from_uri`, `session(...)`), reads (`get_balance`, `get_metagraph`, `fetch_portfolio`), extrinsics (`transfer`, `add_stake`, `set_weights`, dry_run + mev flags), events (`subscribe_events`), localnet (`start`, `dev_accounts`), errors (typed subclasses), config. Use code blocks pulled from `examples/` so they stay tested.

3) Examples. Add `examples/python/` with at least: `connect_and_balance.py`, `transfer_dry_run.py`, `subscribe_events.py`, `localnet_smoke.py`. Each is a small runnable script with `if __name__ == '__main__': asyncio.run(main())`.

4) Pickle blocks. Make every PyO3 pyclass raise `TypeError` on `__reduce__` / `__getstate__` (security: don't accidentally serialize wallets / signers / clients). Add a unit test that confirms `pickle.dumps(wallet)` raises.

5) Security audit. Add `python/SECURITY.md` summarizing: no pickle, password-protected coldkey unlock, sign_message uses sr25519, no key material returned over the binding boundary except via explicit getters (mnemonics returned only at create time). Run `cargo audit -q` and document any findings.

6) Clippy + sdk-only audit. Extend `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
   - Add a `python-clippy` job: `cargo clippy -p agcli-py --features pyo3/extension-module -- -D warnings`.
   - Add a `sdk-only` job: `cargo check --no-default-features --features sdk-only -- -D warnings` (or `cargo clippy`).
   - Update the `python` job to run `pytest -m "not network and not localnet"`.
   - Cache `target/` between runs (Swatinem/rust-cache already in use).
   - Add a `wheels` job that builds wheels via `maturin build --release --strip` for the matrix `{python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12"], os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]}`. Upload artifacts. Don't actually publish to PyPI yet (that's a manual release step).

7) PyPI release prep. Add `python/agcli/__about__.py` (or use `__version__` in __init__.py) and ensure `pyproject.toml` carries description, license, classifiers, project_urls, readme. Add `MANIFEST.in` if needed.

8) Final sanity: run `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo check -p agcli`, `cargo check -p agcli-py`, `cargo check --no-default-features --features sdk-only`, `(cd python && pytest -m 'not network and not localnet')`. Make sure no warnings.

9) Open a draft PR titled `agcli-py: complete Phase 1 polish, Phase 2 extrinsics MVP, Phase 3 features, DX release`, base `main`, head = your worker branch. PR body should summarize the merged-forward Phase 1+2+3+release commits, link to the new docs/tutorials/python-sdk.md, list every new public surface, and include a checklist of acceptance items. Mention that localnet tests are gated behind `@pytest.mark.localnet` and that PyPI publishing is left to a future manual step.

Commit and push, then open the PR via the ManagePullRequest tool with `branch_name = orch/agcli-py/dx-release`, `base_branch = main`, `draft = true`.

tasks.name: verify-release
tasks.scopedGoal: Verify the full agcli-py roadmap shipped on the dx-release branch. Run the build (`cargo check -p agcli-py`, `cargo check --no-default-features --features sdk-only`) and the unit suite (`cd python && maturin develop --manifest-path agcli-py/Cargo.toml && pytest -m 'not network and not localnet'`). Spot-check that the public surface from each phase is present in `python/agcli/__init__.py`, `python/agcli/_native.pyi`, and the .py wrapper modules; that `agcli.errors` defines the typed subclasses; that `agcli.SyncClient` exists; that `agcli.config.Config` round-trips; that `agcli.events`, `agcli.live`, `agcli.localnet`, `agcli.scaffold`, `agcli.admin` exist; that pickling a wallet raises TypeError; that `docs/tutorials/python-sdk.md` and `examples/python/` exist; that `.github/workflows/ci.yml` includes python-clippy + sdk-only + wheels jobs. acceptance: Verification block lists evidence for each acceptance criterion of phases 1-3 and dx-release.
If anything fails to build or test, report verifier-failed with concrete command output.
